label: two clean checks before a clean verdict is reused: main, check on reuse only, and background checks; before and after merging main at 74c0462
note: Real models checked against the sealed hash list, sealed cut-off table, the six busy pages of harmless photos. 'main' is main at 73b6568 (one clean judgement cached). 'on-reuse' is this build with --no-background-checks: a picture seen clean once is judged again only when it comes back. 'background' is this build as shipped: also judged again while the display is still. The reuse case judges each page or view in full at the detector in one uncapped call, so its judgement counts are exact; background judgements are counted apart. The reappear case runs the cover layer with its per-call cap and per-frame time limit, so its per-step counts are capped and not exact. The 'on-reuse-reappear' run was made before the background checks existed (same rule otherwise). Runs on one M1 Max shared with other work (load average about 9), partly on battery: times vary between runs, counts do not. Runs named '*74c0462*' and 'merged-*' are main at 74c0462 (#25) and this branch merged with it; the 'capped' case judges each page in calls of DETECTOR_CALL_CAP.
